<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Character is at right end of bridge. Level not complete. 
# Let me try UP/DOWN to see if character moves vertically.
# Also try clicking on the character itself.

# First try UP
result = action(['UP'])
print(f"UP: board_changed={result['board_changed']}, no_impact={result.get('no_impact')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
char_positions = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['b', 'S'] and n['pixels'] == 2:
        char_positions.append((n['color'], n['boundary']))
print(f"Character: {char_positions}")

# Try DOWN
result = action(['DOWN'])
print(f"\nDOWN: board_changed={result['board_changed']}, no_impact={result.get('no_impact')}")

char_positions = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['b', 'S'] and n['pixels'] == 2:
        char_positions.append((n['color'], n['boundary']))
print(f"Character: {char_positions}")

# Try clicking on the character
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 19, 'col': 41}])
print(f"\nClick char: board_changed={result['board_changed']}, no_impact={result.get('no_impact')}")

char_positions = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['b', 'S'] and n['pixels'] == 2:
        char_positions.append((n['color'], n['boundary']))
print(f"Character: {char_positions}")

</function>
